name: Neha Sharma

quote: Weafix Studios did an excellent job with our home interiors. Vipul and his team were very cooperative throughout the project. The execution was neat, the finishing was excellent and the final look is beautiful.

quote: Bahut accha experience raha Weafix Studios ke saath. Vipul bhai ne design se lekar installation tak sab kuch properly manage kiya. Team professional hai aur finishing bhi ekdum clean hai. Highly recommended!
